name: RDO Equipment Co.
old_description: Shop 650,000 parts, see real-time parts inventory, and view invoices with a FREE RDO Account. Whether you're in the field or your office, access the information you need with your own RDO Account.
about:
RDO Equipment Co. operates a John Deere dealership in Hazen, North Dakota, serving the central region of the state. The location is part of a larger network of RDO Equipment Co. stores, though the founding year and ownership structure of the overall company are not disclosed on this page. The Hazen store is managed by Mike Miller, with Loren Henke handling aftermarket sales.

The dealership sells and services John Deere agriculture equipment, lawn and garden equipment, compact utility tractors, and utility vehicles. It maintains a parts inventory of approximately 650,000 items accessible through an online account system. Service capabilities include machine repair, field technician dispatch, custom hydraulic hose building, precision agriculture technology support, bulk oil and fluid delivery, machine inspections, and after-hours support. Parts can be delivered via route trucks or picked up at drop-off locations.

The primary customers are agricultural producers, landscaping professionals, and property owners in central North Dakota who rely on John Deere equipment for farming, grounds maintenance, and utility tasks. The store also supports precision agriculture technology adoption for row-crop and specialty operations.

The company emphasizes a customer-driven approach, stating that its team focuses on building long-term relationships and trust rather than just making sales. It highlights its people as its most valuable asset and offers conveniences such as text alerts for service updates, curbside pickup, and connected equipment monitoring.
